title: Scorecard telemetry fold over committed records

claims.text: fold_scorecards validates every agent.born and run.close, groups by agent, seat model, effort, mode and memory arm, and returns sorted detached series.
_groups exposes only seat, memory arm, run count, successes, unknown costs and mean costs, keeping unbounded totals private to the fold.
fold indexes public groups by born agent including empty agents, and projection_bytes emits canonical scorecard bytes with a trailing LF.
get filters by seat and memory arm against a journal snapshot and reports the head from the last lamport.

triggers: cost contains bool instead of int

decision.rule: Change here when scorecard grouping, outcome counts, cost means, projection shape or filtering needs to change.
decision.failure: A series merges different seats, a bool is accepted as an integer, or totals leak into the public projection.

questions.q: Where does fold_scorecards group closes by agent, seat and memory arm?
Where should I change successes, unknown-cost or mean-cost computation?
Where can I debug a scorecard that is missing an empty agent?
